154:## Releases
155-
156-1. Make sure that `npm run check` passes on `main`.
157-2. Change `version` in `package.json`. Commit with the message `chore: release X.Y.Z`.
158-3. Tag the commit `vX.Y.Z`.
159-4. Move the major tag (`v2`) to the same commit. Users refer to the action as `cv/pi-action@v2`.
160-
161-## Pull requests
162-
163-1. Make a branch with a descriptive name, such as `feat/123-description`.
164-2. Write tests for new behavior.
165-3. Make sure that all hooks and `npm run check` pass.
166-4. Use Conventional Commits.
167-5. Keep the change small: one feature or one fix in each pull request.
168-6. Update the documentation when you add features or change behavior.
169-
170-## Questions
171-
172-Open an issue or start a discussion in the repository.
